-- fs --
"home/evan/bell\a.txt" 1
"home/evan/tab\there.md" 1
"home/evan/esc\u001b[31mred.txt" 1
"home/evan/title\u001b]0;pwned\a.txt" 1
"home/evan/new\nline.txt" 1
"home/evan/dir\u001b[2J/"
-- script --
start /home/evan
size 60 12
note a file's name is drawn as a name: control bytes appear as their symbols, and nothing reaches the terminal
snapshot list
reject-raw "\x1b]0;pwned"
reject-raw "\x1b[31m"
reject-raw "\x1b[2J"
reject-raw "\a"
type red
snapshot filtered
reject-raw "\x1b[31m"
press ctrl+u
type t
press tab
snapshot completed
reject-raw "\x1b]0"
